overview: The committee reviewed the city's social service infrastructure and discussed municipal responses to local immigration enforcement actions. Members focused on maintaining resident access to healthcare and housing support while exploring legal avenues to identify community members detained by federal authorities.

items.title: Resolution to Assist Residents in Accessing Social Services
items.summary: Health Department staff detailed the city's network of grant-funded community connectors and language-based liaisons who assist vulnerable residents with housing, food security, and MassHealth applications. The matter was kept in committee to allow for ongoing coordination as federal funding shifts occur.

items.title: Resolution on Immigration Enforcement Accountability
items.summary: The committee approved a motion requesting the City Solicitor investigate filing Freedom of Information Act requests for the names of residents detained by immigration enforcement and discussed providing logistical aid to affected families. The resolution was kept in committee to further develop privacy-compliant support strategies.
